title: Three Auditable Demonstrations: Success, Failure, and Unsupported-Regime Fallback
policy_note: These three cases illustrate operational behaviors under real conditions and synthetic fallback testing. They do NOT replace aggregate statistical evaluation.

cases.label: Case 1: Break-Monsoon False Alarm Suppression (Success)
cases.selection_rationale: Illustrates how regime-conditioned mapping successfully suppresses spurious raw NWP convective false alarms during synoptic Break monsoon spells.

measurements.verdict: False alarm eliminated; spurious 68.5mm NWP rain damped to 10.5mm, matching 8.4mm IMD observation.

probability.method: Gaussian survival function with Break-regime residual sigma=1.5mm

cases.label: Case 2: Extreme Convective Deluge Underprediction (Real Failure)
cases.selection_rationale: Transparently exposes Stage 2's fundamental limitation: because LightGBM minimizes continuous L2 error across 38,880 points, it penalizes false alarm overshoots and smooths localized extreme deluges, leading to a missed heavy rain threshold.

measurements.verdict: Failure Case: While Stage 1 reached 68.4mm (crossing heavy rain threshold), Stage 2's negative residual adjustment pulled it down to 54.2mm, resulting in a missed heavy rain event (128.6mm observed). Exposes why Stage 2 POD drops to 0.138.

probability.method: Gaussian survival function around Stage 2 mean (mu=54.2, sigma=23.4)
probability.limitation: Underestimates tail probability due to Gaussian thin tails; fails to trigger urgent evacuation threshold.

cases.label: Case 3: Coastal-Trough Zero-Support Fallback (Synthetic Engineering Fallback)
cases.selection_rationale: Demonstrates the auditable fallback policy when the synoptic classifier identifies Coastal-Trough conditions but training fold has N_k = 0 samples. Prevents pipeline failure by safely routing to Global EQM.

provenance.dataset: Simulated operational boundary test for zero-support regime

rule_trace.condition: Offshore Trough AND Westerly Wind >= 25 kts

measurements.verdict: Fallback Policy Verified: N_k=0 triggered safe routing to Global EQM with fallback_reason='no_regime_training_samples'. No unhandled exceptions; output clearly audited.

probability.limitation: Labeled as unverified coastal regime proxy; zero historical calibration.
